arxiv-1712-01602.title: Measurement of differential cross-sections of a single top quark produced in association with a W W boson at s = 13 TeV \sqrt{s}=$13\text{\,}\text{TeV}$ with ATLAS
arxiv-1712-01602.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1712-01602.description: Abstract The differential cross-section for the production of a W W boson in association with a top quark is measured for several particle-level observables. The measurements are performed using 36.1 ​ fb − 1 {36.1}\,\text{fb}^{-1} of p ​ p pp collision data collected with the ATLAS detector at the LHC in 2015 and 2016.

arxiv-2203-00957.title: Strong gravitational lensing by Bardeen black holes in 4D EGB gravity: constraints from supermassive black holes Strong gravitational lensing by Bardeen black holes in 4D EGB gravity: constraints from supermassive black holes – References
arxiv-2203-00957.creator: Shafqat Ul Islam, Sushant G. Ghosh, Sunil D. Maharaj
arxiv-2203-00957.description: Abstract Observation indicates that many nearby galaxies host supermassive central black holes. Modelling Bardeen models in four-dimensional Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (4D EGB) gravity, with additional parameters α ~ \tilde{\alpha} and charge q q , as central black holes in various galaxies, we investigate gravitational lensing properties in strong deflection limits.

arxiv-2205-07305.title: Gravitational Faraday effect from on-shell amplitudes
arxiv-2205-07305.creator: Wei-Ming Chen, Ming-Zhi Chung, Yu-tin Huang, Jung-Wook Kim
arxiv-2205-07305.description: Abstract Effects of massive object’s spin on massive-massless 2 → 2 2\to 2 classical scattering is studied. Focus is set on the less-considered dimensionless expansion parameter λ / b \lambda/b , where λ \lambda is the massless particle’s wavelength and b b is the impact parameter.

arxiv-2206-05700.title: A Functional Information Perspective on Model Interpretation
arxiv-2206-05700.creator: Itai Gat, Nitay Calderon, Roi Reichart, Tamir Hazan
arxiv-2206-05700.description: Abstract Contemporary predictive models are hard to interpret as their deep nets exploit numerous complex relations between input elements. This work suggests a theoretical framework for model interpretability by measuring the contribution of relevant features to the functional entropy of the network with respect to the input.

arxiv-2305-18634.title: Representation and Simulation of Multivariate Dickman Distributions and Vervaat Perpetuities
arxiv-2305-18634.creator: Michael Grabchak, Xingnan Zhang
arxiv-2305-18634.description: Abstract A multivariate extension of the Dickman distribution was recently introduced, but very few properties have been studied. We discuss several properties with an emphasis on simulation. Further, we introduce and study a multivariate extension of the more general class of Vervaat perpetuities and derive a number of properties and representations.

arxiv-2312-13024.title: Univalent Material Set Theory
arxiv-2312-13024.creator: Håkon Robbestad Gylterud, Elisabeth Stenholm
arxiv-2312-13024.description: Abstract Homotopy type theory (HoTT) can be seen as a generalisation of structural set theory, in the sense that 0-types represent structural sets within the more general notion of types. For material set theory, we also have concrete models as 0-types in HoTT, but this does not currently have any generalisation to higher types.

arxiv-2503-13666.title: Countably compact inverse semigroups and Nyikos’ problem
arxiv-2503-13666.creator: Serhii Bardyla
arxiv-2503-13666.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Serhii Bardyla. A regular separable first-countable countably compact space is called a Nyikos space. In this paper, we give a partial solution to an old problem of Nyikos by showing that each locally compact Nyikos inverse topological semigroup is compact. Also, we show that a topological semigroup S S that contains a dense inverse subsemigroup is a topological inverse semigroup, provided (i) S S is compact, or (ii) S S is countably compact and sequential.

pmc-10597234.title: Navigating end-stage dementia: Between the quality of life and life expectancy, A qualitative study
pmc-10597234.creator: I Halevi Hochwald, G Yakov, Z Radomyslsky, R Nissanholtz-Gannot
pmc-10597234.description: BackgroundCaring for people with end-stage dementia living in the community and restricted to their homes is mainly done by home care units (HCU). Another uncommon program, in Israel, is implemented by the home hospice unit (HHU), specializing in palliative end-of-life care (EOLC).

pmc-11322343.title: Alarm fatigue and sleep quality in medical staff—a Polish-Czech-Slovak study on workplace ergonomics
pmc-11322343.creator: Łukasz Rypicz, Izabela Witczak, Mária Šupínová, Hugh Pierre Salehi, Oľga Jarabicová
pmc-11322343.description: BackgroundAlarms are crucial in informing Healthcare Workers (HCWs) about critical patient needs, but unmanaged frequency and noise of alarms can de-sensitize medical staff and compromise patient safety. Alarm fatigue is identified as the major cause of the clinical alarm management problem. It occurs when the medical staff is overwhelmed by the number of clinical alarms.

pmc-11532906.title: Mari's novel T shaped incision in frenotomy technique with bilateral pedicle flap- an aesthetic approach
pmc-11532906.creator: K Rudhra, Ranjith Mari, Anitha Balaji, Mohan Valiathan
pmc-11532906.description: BackgroundAberrant frenum attachments often lead to mucogingival deformities, culminating in both functional impairments and aesthetic concerns. Traditional frenectomy procedures are associated with extensive incisions and resultant wound defects. To address these challenges, a novel T-shaped incision technique has been developed.

pmc-11572128.title: Investigation of the playing digital games on shoulder flexibility, muscle strength and reaction speed in volleyball players
pmc-11572128.creator: Şeyma Güney, Fatma Neşe Şahin, Cansel Arslanoğlu, Özkan Güler, Mert Aydoğmuş, Abdullah Doğan, Tebessüm Ayyıldız Durhan, Gökhan Arıkan, Onur Mutlu Yaşar, Hamza Küçük
pmc-11572128.description: Esports is a natural extension of digital games. Digital games provide a platform for players to showcase their skills, thereby forming the foundation of e-sports. These two domains continuously support each other, demonstrating significant growth in popularity and establishing a solid presence in the competitive landscape.

pmc-11624838.title: Systematic review of prognostic models for predicting recurrence and survival in patients with treated oropharyngeal cancer
pmc-11624838.creator: Janine Dretzke, Ahmad K Abou-Foul, Esther Albon, Bethany Hillier, Katie Scandrett, Malcolm J Price, David J Moore, Hisham Mehanna, Paul Nankivell
pmc-11624838.description: AbstractObjectivesThis systematic review aims to evaluate externally validated models for individualised prediction of recurrence or survival in adults treated with curative intent for oropharyngeal cancer.DesignSystematic review.SettingHospital care.MethodsSystematic searches were conducted up to September 2023 and records were screened independently by at least two reviewers. The Prediction model Risk Of Bias ASsessment Tool was used to assess risk of bias (RoB).

pmc-12681739.title: Efficiently enhancing ferroptosis-mediated immunosensitization in lung cancer by an inhalable immune activation nanoplatform
pmc-12681739.creator: Zhimin Chen, Yanze Yin, Changjie Yang, Li Ye, Mei Yang, Han Du, Yongfei Fan, Ding-Kun Ji, Yayi He
pmc-12681739.description: Immune checkpoint blockade therapy holds promise for inducing lung cancer regression, but its effectiveness is often limited due to the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (ITME). Ferroptosis can remodel the ITME and enhance immunotherapy, but traditional inducers exhibit weak immune modulation due to off-target toxicity and low drug concentrations at the tumor site, resulting in poor efficacy.

pmc-12767602.title: Co-occurrence of symptoms of substance and behavioral addictions over time: A secondary analysis of longitudinal data from the Cohort Study on Substance Use Risk Factors
pmc-12767602.creator: Andrea Zagaria, Guyonne Rogier, Gerhard Gmel, Simone Amendola
pmc-12767602.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and aimsThe transdiagnostic Syndrome Model of Addiction considers addiction as a syndrome with multiple opportunities for expression, i.e., a common underlying disorder that may manifest in distinctive ways. Considering that testing of the model has been rare, this study examined the co-occurrence of symptoms of substance use disorders and behavioral addictions over 10 years by identifying profiles and predictors associated with group membership.MethodsLongitudinal data (N = 4,760 males) from the Cohort Study on Substance Use Risk Factors (C-SURF) conducted in Switzerland

pmc-12828673.title: Exploring the therapeutic potential of baicalin against MCF-7 breast cancer cells: biochemical, in vitro, and computational perspectives
pmc-12828673.creator: Adil Ali, Tarun Kumar Upadhyay, Lamya Ahmed Al-Keridis, Mohammad Y. Alshahrani, Nawaf Alshamamri, Mohd Saeed
pmc-12828673.description: BackgroundBaicalin (BA), a flavonoid extracted from the dried roots of Scutellaria baicalensis, is well known in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for its anti-apoptotic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. However, its therapeutic potential in breast cancer needs to be evaluated systematically.MethodsIn this study, BA was isolated by probe sonication, bath-assisted sonication, and maceration.

pmc-13181010.title: An expectile-based framework for risk-calibrated credible capacity evaluation of virtual power plants under wind and PV forecast uncertainties
pmc-13181010.creator: Dong Hua, Jihan Zeng, Qinglin Lin, Shunju Cui, Yiqing Liu, Yuzhan Liang
pmc-13181010.description: As renewable penetration continues to increase, virtual power plants (VPPs) are required to evolve from energy aggregators into high-confidence capacity providers capable of delivering firm commitments under uncertainty. The stochastic and asymmetric characteristics of wind and photovoltaic (PV) generation challenge conventional deterministic margins and chance-constrained formulations, which often lead either to excessive conservatism or elevated overcommitment risk.

pmc-13266218.title: Engineered decellularized muscle extracellular matrix fabrics enable functional volumetric muscle loss repair
pmc-13266218.creator: Guangzhou Song, Wenqian Cong, Hongbai Lu, Jiatong Wang, Yumeng Wang, Yanzhen Zhao, Shaowen Wang, Shijie Zhu, Adam C Midgley, Wen Li, Meifeng Zhu
pmc-13266218.description: Volumetric muscle loss (VML) presents a significant clinical challenge, as existing biomaterials fail to recapitulate the anisotropic architecture and pro-regenerative niche that is essential for functional muscle restoration. Although decellularized extracellular matrix (dECM) is bioactive, its exhibits inherently dense structures with poor interconnectivity, that severely restrict cellular infiltration and tissue remodeling.

pmc-13381092.title: Thoracic Aortic Dissection in a Patient With Classical Homocystinuria: Implications for Aortic Surveillance
pmc-13381092.creator: Marisa Chard, Jasmin Simi Zhang, Lesley Turner
pmc-13381092.description: Classical homocystinuria (OMIM #236300), a rare inherited metabolic disorder caused by cystathionine beta‐synthase (CBS) deficiency, is characterized by markedly elevated homocysteine levels and associated multisystem complications. While the role of homocystinuria in venous thromboembolism is well recognized, there is limited evidence of impact on aortic pathology.

pmc-13423174.title: Cell-type-specific m1A dynamics are associated with microglial phenotypic transition and neuronal metabolic adaptation during spinal cord injury
pmc-13423174.creator: Chi Zhang, Shaolong Li, Ruizhi Jiang, Heng Duan, Chuang Li, Enlin Qi, Mingxin Wu, Xueying Li, Shiqing Feng, Hengxing Zhou

pmc-13586064.title: Quality Assessment and Management in Organ Transplantation: A Comparative Analysis of the United States, Germany, and Chinese Mainland
pmc-13586064.creator: Björn Nashan, Miao Pu, Jie Zhao, Haibo Wang
pmc-13586064.description: Organ transplantation is among the most complex domains of modern medicine, requiring the integration of advanced surgical techniques, individualized immunosuppressive therapy, structured professional training, and comprehensive quality assessment systems. As transplantation programs expand globally, ensuring consistency in clinical outcomes and patient safety has become increasingly dependent on the governance structures that regulate these domains.

pmc-13632574.title: Evaluation of Retinal Histological Alterations Following Carbamazepine Administration in Adult Albino Wistar Rats
pmc-13632574.creator: Shumaila Shakoor, Sabahat Zulfiqar, Rahat Bano Siddiqui, Shamaila Ejaz, Huma Qamar, Muhammad Bahadur Baloch, Talha Laique
pmc-13632574.description: BackgroundEpilepsy is characterized by recurrent, unprovoked seizures and is a major global chronic neurological public health concern.ObjectiveTo evaluate retinal histological alterations, focusing on retinal ganglion cell count and apoptosis, following carbamazepine (CBZ) administration in adult albino Wistar rats. It is an antiepileptic drug mainly used for focal (partial) seizures, where it suppresses excessive neuronal firing by blocking voltage-gated Na⁺ channels.
